versions.name: Resica Falls
versions.address: 1200 Resica Falls Rd East Stroudsburg, Pennsylvania 18302

features.note: A pool with a three-story water slide.
Lake Roger, a spring-fed lake used for open boating.
A Wibit aquapark on the lake, with a trampoline and blob.
Includes action archery and sporting arrows.
Open to Scouts fourteen and older.
The High Five Adventure Club for Scouts fourteen and older.
Resica Troop One, a staff-led troop for Scouts attending without their unit.
The Resica Rangers first-year camper program.

sources.citation: Community correction via Camp Finder Suggest-a-Correction form; submitted by a unit that attended 2026-08-14 (submission yXd4qyp), kept anonymous at submitter request. Added first_year_program (Resica Rangers) and high_adventure_option (Paddlerama), plus the webelos program type (Webelos Week for Webelos and Arrow of Light Scouts), all confirmed on the camp's own summer-program pages. The submitter also reported mountain biking and a zip line; neither appears on the camp's full program listing, so both were held pending confirmation.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/525-102013); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
